_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A call on /new starts one blank draft with the composer's selection, wherever the user browses meanwhile. The voice call is faked. In an eval, window.liveEmit(event) delivers event from Live (e.g. window.liveEmit({type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400})); emit each event in its own eval, in the order given. window.liveSpeak(id, speech) speaks and delegates: it emits {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: speech, start_ms: 0, end_ms: 900} and then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 900, delegation: {id, target: "client"}}. window.liveNotes() returns the JSON of everything Shelley sent to Live. window.__voiceTracksStopped counts the microphone tracks stopped. "Start the call" means: click data-testid "live-call-header"; data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". "The exchange" is data-testid "live-exchange". "The message X" is the [data-testid="message"] elements whose text contains X (has_text; it collapses whitespace, so a line break is a space). Text checks on messages and the exchange compare whitespace-collapsed text: eval el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").includes(...) with expect true (or false for "not contain"), on every matching element. "Go within the app to P" means: in an eval, window.history.pushState({}, "", P) and then window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent("popstate")); the page's URL should then end with P (eval location.href.endsWith(P), expect true). The composer has the profile VoicePersonal-test selected (model predictable). The microphone is held: getUserMedia answers only once window.__releaseVoiceMicrophone() is called in an eval. There is a conversation /c/other. Call "profiles loaded" says whether the page has loaded the profiles (/api/profiles answered successfully); call "drafts" counts the requests to /api/conversations/draft; call "session" checks the call start (POST /api/conversation/<id>/live-session) and returns "ok" when it is right; call "promoted" checks the call's conversation as the server has it and returns "ok" when it is right; call "next session" describes the latest call start as JSON. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /new. Call "profiles loaded" should come to return exactly "true".
2. Click data-testid "live-call-header". data-testid "live-bar" should contain "Connecting". Nothing is created before the microphone is granted: call "drafts" should return exactly "0".
3. Go within the app to /c/other. ".header-title" should have text exactly "other".
4. Call window.__releaseVoiceMicrophone(). The live bar should contain "On call".
5. Call "session" should return exactly "ok": the call was started in a new conversation (not /c/other), which the server has as a draft, with model "predictable" and conversation_options carrying the profile VoicePersonal-test and tool overrides, so the call's tasks promote the draft with them.
6. Call window.liveSpeak("first_task", "echo: started by voice"). Call "promoted" should come to return exactly "ok": the conversation is no longer a draft, has model "predictable", and its conversation options name the profile VoicePersonal-test. Call "drafts" should return exactly "1". ".header-title" should still have text exactly "other". window.liveNotes() should come to include '"delegation_id":"first_task","content":"Backend reply: edit predictable.go'.
7. A conversation under way has its own settings; the next call sends none: click data-testid "live-call-origin". There should be exactly one message "Spoken request: echo: started by voice". Click data-testid "live-stop".
8. Click data-testid "live-call-header" again. The live bar should contain "Connecting". Call window.__releaseVoiceMicrophone(); the live bar should contain "On call". Call "next session" should return exactly {"sessions":2,"conversation_options":false}.
9. Click data-testid "live-call-header".
